title: Phase 5: Susi Core runs on its own (MCP server and local daemon)
goal: Foundation plan phase 5, CEO decision B (2026-11-22): a small runtime that starts on its own, grown one working capability at a time. First capability: susi mcp serve answers MCP over stdio with read-only file tools confined to one root (list_directory, read_file, search_files), and susi start | status | stop run a local daemon on 127.0.0.1:9090+offset with an open /health and a token-protected POST /mcp. Then the commands that only forward to the removed runtime host, and the empty pillar packages, go.

reuse.searched: Susi Core first: susi-gmcp (a 20-line socket), susi_core::plane_bus::tools (forwards to a runtime host that left Susi on 2026-11-22), susi-gawd-acp (wire contracts only), scoped_tools (owner traits, no tools). The lockfile already has serde_json, used through the vendor facade; HTTP needs only std::net for a localhost daemon, so hyper and tokio are not pulled into the binary. Susi Tools' program uses no outside crates.
reuse.reason: No runtime exists in Susi Core to reuse; the MCP protocol handling and three read-only tools are small and written fresh for Core under Apache-2.0.
